readerCopy.summary: A difficult story is told with enough clarity to move people without exploiting the person at its center.
readerCopy.body: Mercury trine Neptune also helps difficult stories be told with honesty and care. Testimony, reporting, art, or a private conversation can hold the emotional truth while keeping dates, names, and responsibilities intact. Mercury keeps the account clear. Neptune keeps the grief, compassion, and emotional meaning present. Fact and feeling support each other instead of forcing people to choose one over the other. The facts do not need to be softened to make people care, and the emotions do not need to be exaggerated to make the truth matter. The story carries more weight because its emotional force does not depend on blurring what actually happened.
